items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1975-05-15
items.q: I'm glad to know Skip is a good engineer.

ctx.x: Do you want to do the whole thing over again?

Yeah, so it'll be smoothly wound. As I tell you, it's dangerous. I don't want to take any chances with tapes like this. It's too valuable. Clean the machine, demagnetize it this morning. We're going to run it off smooth, wild. I'm glad to know Skip is a good engineer.
We might as well cut that off to a couple of weeks.
